title: QUIC RFC 9000 MAX_STREAMS Monotonic Limit Update Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S4P6 requirement-home tests over MAX_STREAMS monotonic peer-limit updates, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the generated non-clean S4P6 MAX_STREAMS monotonic update tail.
expected_result: The focused tests show that larger MAX_STREAMS frames increase only the matching bidirectional or unidirectional peer limit, smaller frames received after a larger value have no effect, stale smaller frames after multiple increases have no effect, and equal non-increasing frames are ignored for both stream directions.
procedure: Run the focused S4P6 MAX_STREAMS requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The S4P6 stream-limit local-open and inbound STREAM enforcement tail remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0076.
The base stream-state model remains owned by ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim automatic stream-limit autotuning, public stream API widening, broader stream-credit policy, hosted interop readiness, or closure of the deferred S4P6-0010 fuzz expectation.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The focused S4P6 MAX_STREAMS filter passed 8/8, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0010 and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0011 trace_clean and reports 1,301 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 475 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,556/4,556, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
